description: Painted replacements at historical fixture paths. Geometry archive contains channel sums and alpha only, never the original coloured illustrations. Technical light kernels remain functional masks. Superseded entries keep only the measured geometry of a copy a later art pack replaced: the file is not exported (review REND-10), the bakers still read its silhouette and bounds.
